summary: Both backend and frontend tested end-to-end for the Morabangun.com Laravel landing page. All 13 pytest backend cases pass (landing render, all required data-testids, CSRF meta, portfolio live links, contact validation 422, happy-path 200, /api/contact alias, [MORABANGUN_CONTACT_LEAD] + info@morabangun.com mock-mail body persisted to /app/storage/logs/laravel.log). Frontend Playwright covers hero map SVG, bilingual toggle with localStorage 'mbs_locale' persistence across reload, mobile hamburger menu, anchor scrolling, all 6 portfolio cards with correct target=_blank live URLs, contact form full submit returning Indonesian success message, and zero console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile hamburger button and mobile-only language toggle have no data-testid. Spec requires data-testid on every interactive element; currently only the desktop lang-toggle and nav-cta-btn carry them. Suggest data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle' and data-testid='lang-toggle-mobile'.

Stats numbers (50+, 25+, 6) sit inside a 'scroll-reveal' container, so they are initially hidden via opacity/transform until an IntersectionObserver fires. They render correctly once revealed, but automated DOM scans before any scroll see no innerText for the counters. Consider revealing them on initial load when already in viewport.

action_items: Add data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle' (and optionally 'lang-toggle-mobile') in /app/resources/views/components/navigation.blade.php for QA stability.
Optional: trigger the scroll-reveal animation immediately for above-the-fold hero stats so the numbers 50+/25+/6 are visible without scrolling.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactController correctly validates with Laravel Validator, returns 422 with errors object, persists [MORABANGUN_CONTACT_LEAD] via Log::info and writes mocked mail body to laravel.log — implementation matches spec.
Routes web.php exposes both POST /contact and POST /api/contact via the same controller — alias works as required.
CSRF protection is enabled (verified by reading <meta name='csrf-token'> and sending X-CSRF-TOKEN header from session).
Mail driver is 'log' (mocked) — clearly intentional; lead body lands in /app/storage/logs/laravel.log. When user later sets real SMTP creds, no code change needed.

navigation.blade.php hard-codes ID/EN strings in twin <span x-show> blocks. Consider extracting strings to a single Alpine.store or Laravel lang files to reduce duplication if scaling beyond 2 locales.
WhatsApp placeholder '+62 812-XXXX-XXXX' is intentional per product brief and NOT a bug.
Portfolio cards are static CSS mockups (per user choice) — no iframe security exposure, all anchor tags carry rel implicit + target=_blank to live URLs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (hero, lang-toggle+persistence, mobile hamburger, contact form happy path, anchor scroll, portfolio links, 0 console errors)

test_credentials: N/A — public landing page, no auth.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use TEST_ prefixed payloads sent to mocked /contact endpoint; data is logged-only (no DB writes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Laravel app served via supervisor (laravel-web:3000, laravel-api:8001). Mail mock writes to /app/storage/logs/laravel.log — grep for '[MORABANGUN_CONTACT_LEAD]' and 'info@morabangun.com' to validate. CSRF: GET / first, read <meta name='csrf-token'>, send via X-CSRF-TOKEN header and preserve session cookie OR use the /api/contact alias. Hero section is id='home' (not '#hero'). All required data-testids are present except on the mobile hamburger and mobile lang button — flagged as LOW priority.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs detected. Two LOW-priority UX/QA improvements noted: missing data-testids on mobile-only buttons and hero stat counters hidden behind scroll-reveal on first paint.
